description:
This role is for one of Weekday's clients. 
 
 Role Type: Contractor
 Location: Fully Remote – No Geographic Restrictions
 Compensation: $90–$155 USD per hour
 Duration: Initial engagement covering 20 part packages, with a production phase to follow.
 About the Opportunity
 We are looking for experienced Mechanical Design Engineers with a strong background in designing precision CNC-machined components for robotics applications. This opportunity is ideal for professionals with at least five years of relevant production engineering experience, access to parametric CAD software, and the technical authority to make or approve critical design decisions.
 In this role, you will create original CAD part packages from scratch and conduct technical peer reviews of designs submitted by other engineers. Each assignment involves developing a complex, high-value CNC component with a specific manufacturing challenge, supported by detailed engineering drawings, complete GD&T specifications, design documentation, and a realistic production scenario.
 Your practical engineering judgment, manufacturing expertise, and ability to justify technical decisions are central to this engagement. Each submitted package will be independently evaluated by three other engineers, and you will also review their work. Previous AI experience is not required.
 Requirements 
 Key Responsibilities
 Original CAD Design: Develop new mechanical components for robotics applications using parametric CAD software. Deliver designs in native CAD formats along with STEP files.
 Technical Drawing Preparation: Create comprehensive engineering drawings covering:
 Component dimensions and tolerances
 Geometric Dimensioning and Tolerancing (GD&T)
 Datum specifications
 Material selection and material condition
 Surface finish requirements
 Revision details and applicable drawing standards
 Design Documentation: Document the engineering context of each component, including its intended function, interface requirements, operating conditions, specific machining challenges, and the rationale behind material and manufacturing process selection.
 Production Scenario Development: Prepare realistic manufacturing estimates covering:
 Estimated unit cost and key cost drivers
 CNC machining cycle times and setup hours
 Assumed production volumes
 Sourcing complexity and material availability
 Expected manufacturing lead times
 Provide clear engineering assumptions and supporting rationale for every estimate.
 Technical Peer Reviews: Evaluate packages developed by other engineers based on technical quality, manufacturing feasibility, production realism, and overall engineering value. Support every assessment and score with specific, part-related evidence.
 Design Revisions: Incorporate feedback from independent reviews and revise your own packages to address technical issues and improve design quality.
 Required Qualifications
 Relevant Industry Experience: At least five years of production engineering experience designing CNC-machined components, materials, and manufacturing processes specifically for robotics applications.
 Technical Decision-Making Authority: Demonstrated ownership or approval responsibility for critical engineering decisions, including:
 Engineering drawing approvals
 Tolerance and material selection
 Production release authorization
 Establishing and enforcing engineering quality standards
 Suitable candidates include Design Leads, Principal Engineers, Staff Engineers, and other senior technical authorities.
 OEM or Specialist Supplier Experience: Previous experience working with robotics OEMs or specialized engineering suppliers, with the ability to apply and reproduce established engineering standards.
 GD&T and Tolerancing Expertise: Strong understanding of geometric dimensioning and tolerancing, including their impact on manufacturing costs, inspection requirements, and production feasibility.
 Parametric CAD Proficiency: Access to professional parametric CAD software such as SolidWorks, Siemens NX, CATIA, PTC Creo, or equivalent, with the ability to deliver native CAD files and STEP formats.
 Industry Experience: Practical, hands-on industrial engineering experience is essential. Academic or research-only experience will not meet the requirements.
 Originality and Intellectual Property Requirements
 All designs submitted must be independently created and represent your original engineering work.
 Designs owned by current or former employers or customers must not be used.
 Publicly available or commercially purchased CAD models cannot be substituted for original designs.
 All submitted deliverables will become the client's property.
 Candidates who are currently employed should review their employment agreements, particularly clauses concerning outside engagements, intellectual property, and invention assignment, before applying.
 Selection Process
 Application: Submit your application and complete the required screening questions.
 AI Interview: Complete a role-specific AI interview designed to assess your technical knowledge and relevant engineering experience. This interview is an essential part of presenting your expertise to the client.
 Profile Review: Your professional background will be evaluated, including evidence of comparable CNC-machined robotics components and critical engineering decisions you have owned or approved.
 Onboarding: Selected candidates will receive engagement details and onboarding support from the Talent Operations team before beginning the project.
